canonicalAsset.clearSpace: one central-aperture width on every side
canonicalAsset.wordmark: Set OpenCoven as live text in the display role; do not outline or distort the name.
canonicalAsset.lockup: Mark, then wordmark, separated by one spacing-2 unit. Keep the mark optically centered.
canonicalAsset.favicon: Use the mark alone on a single high-contrast field.
canonicalAsset.og: Use the mark, one concise message, and generous negative space; alt text must describe the message, not decorative geometry.

typography.display: Geist, Inter, SF Pro Display, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.reading: Inter, SF Pro Text, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.mono: SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

density.narrative: 48–96 px vertical bands with a 60–68 ch reading measure
density.evidence: 16–24 px internal spacing with aligned labels and values
density.action: 8–16 px gaps; one filled action per decision surface

motion.reducedMotion: Remove translation, scale, parallax, autoplay, and decorative looping while preserving state changes immediately.

statusSemantics.presence: A live/connected embodiment; violet plus a text label or shape.
statusSemantics.action: A user-invoked operation; never reuse presence color as the only cue.
statusSemantics.verified: Evidence-backed success; green treatment plus check/text.
statusSemantics.pending: Waiting, reconciling, or stale; amber treatment plus clock/text.
statusSemantics.blocked: Rejected, failed, or unavailable; red treatment plus icon/text.
statusSemantics.evidence: Neutral receipt, provenance, or unknown state; neutral surface plus explicit wording.

imagery.illustration: Prefer geometric, architectural, or editorial diagrams over fake product screenshots.
imagery.screenshots: Use current product captures with source revision, date, and descriptive alt text.
imagery.threeD: Optional progressive enhancement only. Never render-critical; pauseable; no information may depend on motion or WebGL.
imagery.mark: Flat monochrome only. Do not add gradients, glow, smoke, sparkles, or retired hood/trident geometry.

voice.principle: Clear, technically grounded, emotionally resonant, never fake-mystical.
voice.rule: Familiar and magical language must immediately clarify architecture, authority, evidence, or behavior.
avoid: Decorative occult language that obscures the mechanism
